respins.how_it_works:
EchoSpins™ are a special type of respins where each spin is a copy of the triggering spin. When the Skeleton Hand scatter symbol lands together with at least one winning payline, it reveals the number of EchoSpins™ awarded. 1-5 EchoSpins™ can be awarded by the Skeleton Hand.

 All Wild Multipliers on the reels during EchoSpins™ are added again to the Global Multiplier on every spin! The Global Multiplier resets after EchoSpins™ have ended.

wilds.name: WILD MULTIPLIERS & GLOBAL MULTIPLIER
wilds.behavior:
The Wild symbol has a chance to land as a Wild Multiplier symbol with a multiplier value. When one or more Wild Multiplier scatter symbols land together with at least one winning payline, their multiplier values are added to a Global Multiplier on top of the reels. The Global Multiplier value multiplies all wins on the current spin!

 Wild Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

wilds.name: BONES GAME
wilds.behavior:
The Bones Game feature awards 10 free spins with better odds of landing a Skeleton Hand to trigger EchoSpins™! There is also a higher chance of getting more EchoSpins™ than in the base game, all the way up to 5 awarded spins!

 The bonus is triggered by landing 3 Bones Game scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all Low or High paying symbols.

 Only one Skeleton Hand symbol can land at the time. The Skeleton Hand symbol substitutes for all paying symbols except the Wild symbol.

 The Bones Game symbol appears only in the base game.
